messages:
jonah: Heads up — noticed a small but recurring spike in invoice-preview totals when a route fallback triggers. Seen 3 customers this week with +1.2x estimated tokens for the preview vs final invoice. @anika can you take a look? :eyes:

anika: Thanks, Jonah. Which path is the fallback taking? is it the cheap-model -> high-cost-model fallback or region fallback?

jonah: It looks like model-variant fallback (cheap -> q8_128 -> fp16) where both the primary and fallback events sometimes get counted in the preview. The final invoice pipeline dedupes ok, but previewing (in console + email preview) is generated from the streaming aggregation which has a shorter dedupe window.

kevin: Paging billing-bot just in case we have an alert correlation. billing-bot: can you post the last two events for tenant `acme-inc` for today?

billing-bot: (automated) event snippet for tenant=acme-inc, latest 2:
```
{
  "evt_id": "evt_2026_03_20_01",
  "route": "model-a",
  "dedupe_key": "r12345-1",
  "tokens": 420
}
{
  "evt_id": "evt_2026_03_20_02",
  "route": "model-a-fallback",
  "dedupe_key": "r12345-1",
  "tokens": 430
}
```

maya: So both events have same dedupe_key but different route tags. Our preview aggregation groups by route tag for per-route breakdown, but dedupe runs across tenant+session only later. That explains why the preview shows two line items.

anika: Ugh. That UX is bad — customers see apparent double-charge in the preview even though invoice is correct. We should either: 1) make preview dedupe use the same dedupe logic as invoice (preferred), or 2) show a warning that per-route breakdown may double-count fallbacks.

kevin: Option 1 has perf implications: preview is computed in the streaming path (low-latency), invoice uses offline dedupe with a wider window and cross-shard quorum. We can either pull dedupe into streaming (adds state and memory) or delay preview by a few minutes and run offline-style dedupe.

jonah: For short-term, can we emit a console needle/annotation on the route breakdown that flags suspected fallback duplication if two events share dedupe_key within Xs? Quick UI fix.

anika: Yep we can add a banner: "Possible duplicate tokens due to fallback routing — final invoice dedupes within 10m". I'll file a small UX task. But we should track engineering follow-up to align dedupe logic.

kevin: I'll prototype a streaming dedupe bloom filter keyed by dedupe_key+tenant with 10m TTL. Low mem if we accept some false positives. That would reduce double-lines in preview.

maya: Also update console docs and add an alert to monitor preview vs invoice delta > 5% for a tenant over 1h. We had two noise alerts last week that were actually previews; want fewer false positives.

anika: Creating ticket ENG-plat-2732: "Preview dedupe parity for route-fallbacks" with links to the event snippets and proposed bloom-filter approach. Assigning to Kevin to prototype. Jonah, can you add a couple of repro tenants and exact timestamps?

jonah: Yep will add repro data in the ticket and include a small k8s log snippet from the routing-proxy.

kevin: Quick note — if we do streaming bloom filter we need to consider multi-instance consistency. Might need a lightweight partitioning by tenant to keep it local. I'll sketch tradeoffs.

billing-bot: (automated) alert: invoice-preview delta >5% for tenant=acme-inc, window=1h (count=3). Logged as incident ref: INC-2026-0421-preview-delta

jonah: Thanks all. Short-term: UX banner + doc + ticket. Medium-term: prototype streaming dedupe OR move preview to offline dedupe. Will update here after Kevin's prototype. :thumbsup:

maya: Great. If anyone wants to join the deep-dive tomorrow 10am, I'll book a quick sync.

anika: I'll be there.

kevin: Me too.

jonah: I'll bring logs and repro steps.

(ended)
